title: 第264章 魔鬼训练第263章 滚
slug: 大婚之日我阉了未婚妻的白月光
content_zh:
跟着纳兰风云，回到内院。
叶凡惊讶道：“老爷子，你这样出手，真不怕纳兰家族报复吗？”
纳兰风云一笑，耐人寻味的看着叶凡：“你得血色商会、中州王家，甚至当众斩杀血色商会大长老的时候，不是也不怕报复吗？”
看到叶凡表情怪异。
纳兰风云道：“小子，你放心。”
“只要纳兰家族的人知道，老夫恢复了四条武脉！就绝对不敢再对老夫动手！”
“你可知道，四条武脉意味着什么？哪怕是圣地之主，也只有三条武脉！”
“当年，老夫可是北海第一天才！纳兰家族因为老夫，才有今天的地位！他们敢动我？你让他们动一个试试！”
纳兰风云十分自信。
叶凡心中却有些惊讶。
三条武脉就能当圣主？
“哼！还有你小子，手握这么多资源，居然才是一个一阶武王？”
“你也太懒了！让老夫看看你的天赋！”
说完，不等叶凡反应。
抬手一扣，抓住叶凡的手腕。
下一秒。
纳兰风云的眸子一颤，瞪大眼睛，不敢置信的盯着叶凡：“你……嘶！怎么可能！”
他惊恐的松手，后退好几步！
又忍不住，再次上前一步，一把抓住叶凡的手腕：“嘶！我的天！真的是十二武脉！你体内居然拥有十二条武脉？我草！”
纳兰风云再也控制不住形象，整个人直接跳起来！

激动！
颤抖！
呼吸急促！
看向叶凡的目光，全都变了！
像是看一个怪物！彻头彻尾的怪物！
又像是看一件完美的珍宝！一件无瑕的艺术品！
“十二条武脉！居然是传说中的十二条武脉！小子，你怎么不早说！”纳兰风云浑身发抖，激动的语无伦次，在院子里来回踱步。
“你知道十二条武脉意味着什么吗？”
叶凡回答：“知道啊，同境界，十二倍的内力！十二倍战斗力！十二倍力量！”
纳兰风云怒道：“这是谁告诉你的？这可不是单纯的十二倍！这是无敌！”
“若是给老夫十二条武脉！老夫就是北海第一！”
“若是给老夫十二条武脉，老夫敢叫圣地换主人！”
“若是给老夫十二条武脉，老夫有生之年，绝对可以成为一尊武神！”
叶凡愕然：“不会吧，成为武神有这么简单？”
纳兰风云气的捶胸顿足：“小子，你以为武脉是什么？”
“你师父是谁？让他滚出来！”
“好好的一个苗子，居然被他培养成这样！可恶！暴殄天物啊！”
叶凡摸了摸鼻子。
如果叶弑天听到这句话，不知道是什么反应？
心中正想着，纳兰风云低喝一声：“从现在开始，你哪儿都不许去，就留在老夫身边！”

“老夫要亲自教导你，一阶武王？不够看！”
“未来，你要成为一个武尊！去和圣地的那些圣子，神女争锋！哈哈哈哈……”
纳兰风云越说越激动，手舞足蹈。
在原地跳脚！
他老脸通红，似乎已经想象到，一尊自己亲手培养的武神，君临天下的那一天！
content_en:
Follow Nalan Fengyun back to the inner courtyard.
Ye Fan was surprised and said: "Old man, are you really not afraid of the Nalan family's revenge if you take action like this?"
Nalan Fengyun smiled and looked at Ye Fan intriguingly: "You won the Scarlet Chamber of Commerce, the Wang Family of Zhongzhou, and even when you killed the elder of the Scarlet Chamber of Commerce in public, weren't you afraid of revenge?"
Seeing Ye Fan's expression was strange.
Nalan Fengyun said: "Boy, don't worry."
"As long as the people of the Nalan family know that I have restored my four martial arts veins! They will never dare to do anything to me again!"
"Do you know what four martial veins mean? Even the Lord of the Holy Land only has three martial veins!"
"Back then, I was the number one genius in Beihai! The Nalan family is where it is today because of me! Do they dare to touch me? Let them try!"
Nalan Fengyun is very confident.
Ye Fan was a little surprised.
Can you become a Holy Master with three martial arteries?
"Hmph! And you kid, with so many resources in your hands, you are actually a first-order Martial King?"
"You're too lazy! Let me see your talent!"
After speaking, he didn’t wait for Mark’s reaction.
He raised his hand and grabbed Ye Fan's wrist.
The next second.
Nalan Fengyun's eyes trembled, widened, and stared at Mark in disbelief: "You... hiss! How is that possible!"
He let go in fear and took several steps back!
Unable to bear it anymore, he stepped forward again and grabbed Ye Fan's wrist: "Hi! Oh my God! It's really twelve martial arteries! You actually have twelve martial arteries in your body? What a fool!"
Nalan Fengyun could no longer control his image and jumped up!
Excited!
Tremble!
Shortness of breath!
The look in Ye Fan's eyes has completely changed!
It's like looking at a monster! A complete monster!
It's like looking at a perfect treasure! A flawless piece of art!
"Twelve martial arteries! It's actually the legendary twelve martial arteries! Boy, why didn't you tell me earlier!" Nalan Fengyun was trembling all over, speaking incoherently with excitement, pacing back and forth in the yard.
"Do you know what the twelve martial veins mean?"
Ye Fan replied: "I know, in the same realm, twelve times the internal strength! Twelve times the combat effectiveness! Twelve times the strength!"
Nalan Fengyun said angrily: "Who told you this? This is not simply twelve times! This is invincible!"
"If you give me twelve martial arts veins! I will be the best in Beihai!"
"If you give me twelve martial arts veins, I dare to ask the Holy Land to change its owner!"
"If you give me twelve martial arts veins, I can definitely become a martial god in my lifetime!"
Ye Fan was stunned: "No way, is it so easy to become a Martial God?"
Nalan Fengyun beat his chest angrily: "Boy, what do you think the martial arts is?"
"Who is your master? Get him out!"
"A good seedling was trained like this by him! Damn it! Such a waste of resources!"
Ye Fan touched his nose.
If Ye Shitian heard this, I wonder what his reaction would be?
Just as he was thinking in his mind, Nalan Fengyun shouted: "From now on, you are not allowed to go anywhere, just stay with me!"
"I want to personally teach you, the first-order Martial King? It's not enough!"
"In the future, you will become a Martial Lord! Go and compete with those saints and goddesses in the Holy Land! Hahahaha..."
The more Nalan Fengyun talked, the more excited he became, dancing with joy.
Jumping in place!
His old face turned red, as if he had already imagined the day when a martial god whom he personally cultivated would rule the world!
